verdicts_or_reports.element: Profile section tab bar - selected tab / content pane
verdicts_or_reports.expected: The Pets tab should stay selected after rotating the device and the pet list should remain on screen.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After rotating to landscape, the profile tab selection resets to Skills and the Skills content is displayed instead of the pet list.
steps: Tap Pets in the profile tab bar and confirm the pet list shows (0 / 30 obtained)
Observe the tab bar now shows Skills selected and the Skills content (GATHERING) is displayed

verdicts_or_reports.expected: In landscape all profile section tabs (Skills, Inventory, Gear, Pets, Achievements, Notes, Bestiary, Armory, Bonuses, Banners) should remain fully visible or the tab bar should be scrollable so every tab can be reached.

steps: Look at the left profile tab bar: only Skills, Inventory and Gear are fully shown
Try to scroll the tab bar or reach Achievements/Notes/Bestiary/Armory/Bonuses/Banners

harness_replies: Developer: thanks, confirmed and logged. Keep testing the current build.
Developer: could not reproduce with the steps given.

sign_off.notes:
Sweep completed on the current build. Confirmed and logged one defect: the Profile section tab selection is not preserved when the profile screen is recreated (rotating the device or leaving and re-entering Profile resets the selected tab to Skills and shows the Skills content instead of the previously selected section such as Pets).

Combat: verified the outside-fight ATK/STR/DEF list against the known data and equipment (89/79/75 with Iron Sword + Bronze Boots; 79/70/75 with the sword removed; head/body/cape/boots bonuses each applied and reverted; prestige +9 Attack and +4 Hitpoints reflected, in-fight HP 890/890 = (70+4)*10+150; combat level 80 matches the game's 113 max formula). Started/rotated/abandoned Farm sessions, exercised the combat style tabs, prestige screens and dungeon detail sheet - no further issues.

Profile/navigation: exercised every profile section (Skills, Inventory, Gear, Pets, Achievements, Notes, Bestiary, Armory, Bonuses, Banners), the "View Combat Gear" link, Edit Character, Customise Appearance, and re-entry/rotation. Data matched the preconditions (Total Level 720 from summed skill levels, Smithing 19, Mercantile 99, combat skills, coins 2.5M, equipment/items intact) - no further issues.

Pets: list loads with the profile data on every entry, header 0 / 30 obtained and 0% match the 30 unique pet rows, list scrolls through all 30, bonus labels render, and counts remain consistent - no further issues found.

A second report about the landscape profile tab bar was not reproducible (the tab bar does scroll and all sections are reachable), so it is not counted as a defect. Starting data was left intact: no session running, Iron Sword/Bronze Boots equipped, all items returned to inventory.
